verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community indexing tip about tuning the refresh interval during bulk indexing. It implies that Elasticsearch itself supports indexing many documents in bulk, but no first-party documentation in the pack describes a bulk API or how bulk operations work. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a bulk API, coverage of bulk update/delete beyond indexing, error handling and limits, and agent-oriented usage (e.g., via the MCP server or clients).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
